issue.title: Status of testing Providers that were prepared on June 19, 2026
issue.body:
I have a kind request for all the contributors to the latest provider distributions release.
Could you please help us to test the RC versions of the providers?

The guidelines on how to test providers can be found in

[Verify providers by contributors](https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/main/dev/README_RELEASE_PROVIDERS.md#verify-the-release-candidate-by-contributors)

Let us know in the comments, whether the issue is addressed.

These are providers that require testing as there were some substantial changes introduced:

Hi everyone,

Just a heads-up that the previous release candidate appears to have introduced a regression in `apache-airflow-providers-cncf-kubernetes` version 10.18.0 and this RC still contains the regression.

We actually caught this while testing the `apache-airflow-providers-google` package. Since upgrading the Kubernetes provider, our tasks are failing with a 401 Unauthorized connection error when trying to authenticate with the cluster.

For anyone else landing here while troubleshooting: downgrading to version `10.17.1` resolves the issue as a temporary workaround.

I'm currently working on an ad-hoc release, it would be best to include the fix there.
